name: request_repository
description: Ask the person whether another repository may join this workspace. Use it when the task needs a repository the person did not name: to read something from it, or to change it too. The person is asked a yes or no question that this tool writes, with your reason, and only a yes adds the repository: then call prepare_workspace with it. A no is final for this task: do not ask again for the same repository and do not look for another way to change it.

reason.description: Why the task needs this repository, in one plain sentence (at most 300 characters). The person reads it.
